name: Elnic Vesswyn
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: Assembled the largest library in England and advised on navigation for the northern voyages.
text: Elnic vesswyn of the fourth watch, keeps the book for the 14th tranche, doors 124 to 133. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads John Dee.
